aggregates.claim: A finite ledger over the exact current collected suite, with every execution ID, primary requirement, input/profile fingerprint, current adjudication, declared phase and evidence class bound into the inventory review. Inventory adjudication is distinct from case approval: explicit current needs-oracle or disputed members remain listed, unapproved and ineligible for qualified passes. Unreviewed, stale or falsely labelled reference evidence cannot be silently adopted. Declared-valid runtime effects, other effects, positive admission controls, undefined-result contexts and invalid-input diagnostics have separate populations. Actual observations are joined by exact ID and compiler configuration without adding an execution or attributing a canonical case to this requirement.
aggregates.limitation: Observational infrastructure only: S4.2-001's facet remains pending until the source/requirement census, complete conforming fixture/oracle inventory and separate processor/dependency qualifications are independently established. No finite run proves the universal processor obligation. A filtered invocation retains all unselected members in its denominator. XFAILs remain failures; skips, unsupported modes, missing profiles, unavailable launchers, unexecuted run effects and provisional observations cannot become qualified passes. A compile/link admission is not execution of an interpretation, and a context-only run is not an assertion about an undefined value. Resource failures do not establish permitted size/complexity limits. Compiler headers, companions, launchers and profile observations describe the selected interface, not ABI certification or universal portability. Paragraphs 7-8 are recommendations, not manufactured mandatory documentation requirements.

review.rationale: Explicit source-context renewal of the unchanged 2083-member inventory after the independently reviewed 10.1.10, 10.1.11 and 10.1.12 source registration in doc/source_audits/batch_105.json. All 2083 case bindings, their fingerprints, 2047 raw reviews, 206 older catalogues, 22 links, R402 and the b153c75b baseline remain exact. Only 17 of the 25 scoped base units are newly accounted, because R1029, C1011, R1030, C1012, R1031, C1013, R1032 and C1014 were already accounted; each was verified as neither double-counted nor dropped, and each is used directly as a requirement identifier. 117 new facets remain pending. This is the first constraint-dense scope in Clause 10, so almost every plan is a negative, and it took three review rounds. The zero-permissions verdict was independently adjudicated and accepted: every may and permitted only if in this scope, including the TRANSFER text, conditionally admits a program construct rather than granting the processor latitude. Three findings were raised and closed, two of them the same class: C10CSR-001 and C10CSR-003 filed diagnostic negatives against 10.1.10 p1 and 10.1.11 p4, both of which define terms and prohibit nothing, the prohibition living in C1011 and p2 instead. C10CSR-002 added the missing OPTIONAL and INTENT(OUT) ownership dependencies verified at 8.5.10/R828/C845-C849, 8.6.9/R852, 8.5.12/C851 and 8.6.10/R853. A required full sweep found a fourth instance at p9 and produced a 38-row table naming, for every remaining diagnostic plan, the exact prohibiting words and the single differing property; the reviewer spot-checked twelve high-risk row groups against the pinned document and found them sound. This establishes a project-wide precedent that a facet may carry a diagnostic expectation only if the unit it is filed under actually prohibits something. Three dependency owners, 15.5.2.1, 15.5.2.4 and 15.5.2.13, are not yet registered, so the C1011 exclusion negatives cannot be implemented until they are. No specification-expression or constant-expression execution, canonical link or SourceUse observation is supplied, and no compiler was invoked. The eight substring executions integrated in batch099 remain the latest actual observations. All pending facets, unresolved units, the retained needs-oracle real-BOZ block and every global gate remain open.
